name: Banswara Syntex Ltd
title: Banswara Syntex Ltd-$ - 503722 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Yarn utilisation fell to 77% on labour shortages while Fabric and Garment carry growth; FY27 revenue guided to INR1,450–1,500 crores with EBITDA margin 10.5–11%, but net debt rose to INR483 crores with no long-term debt reduction until FY28.

utilisation.quote: The capacity utilization stood at 78% during quarter four FY26 and 77% for the full year.

capex.quote: The capex has been planned around INR135 crores to INR140 crores.

triggers.label: Yarn utilisation 77% FY26, labour-constrained
triggers.quote: Lower utilization levels during the quarter were primarily due to the labor shortages, particularly in spinning

triggers.label: Yarn realisations up INR30-35 per kg
triggers.quote: realizations did improve during the year by approximately INR30 to INR35 per kilo

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR1,450-1,500 crores
triggers.quote: expect revenues between the range of INR1,450 crores to INR1,500 crores in FY 2027

triggers.label: Net debt up to INR483 crores
triggers.quote: The net debt as on 31st March , 2026 stood at INR483 crores as compared to INR456 crores

triggers.label: Garment revenue +40% in Q4 to INR96 crores
triggers.quote: The Garment revenues increased in the last quarter by 40% to INR96 crores

guidance.quote: expect revenues between the range of INR1,450 crores to INR1,500 crores in FY 2027
we expect margins to remain between the range of 10.5% to 11% over the medium-term
The capex has been planned around INR135 crores to INR140 crores.

prior_guidance_check.quote: the FY26 revenues increased year -on-year by 5% to a record of INR569 crores

red_flags.label: Net debt up INR27 crores; no LT debt reduction until FY28
red_flags.quote: there will not be a reduction. You will see some high in long term FY2027 due to planned capex on that.

red_flags.label: Yarn utilisation labour-constrained, unresolved into Q1
red_flags.quote: the labor shortages still continue to be a challenge in spinning

evasions.topic: Garment segment EBITDA and timeline to INR2,000 crores revenue
evasions.quote: let's give this a break until the next quarter and then maybe we can address this better
the segmental EBITDA will be a misleading or rather not an accurate one
